guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails during the installation of system dependencies with the error: 'failed to export layer: CreateDiff: mount callback failed on /var/lib/containerd/tmpmounts/...: failed to write compressed diff: failed to create diff tar stream: lstat /var/lib/containerd/tmpmounts/containerd-mount326425764/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libnghttp2.so.14: no such file or directory'. This indicates a problem related to the Docker storage or overlay filesystem, or possibly a corrupted or incomplete package in the image layer processing. This is not an issue directly caused by the Dockerfile commands or missing dependencies, but rather a low-level Docker/container runtime issue during image layering. To address this, please try the following: 1) Clear Docker builder cache and system prune Docker resources to remove any corrupted caches. 2) Consider switching to another base image or a different docker build environment to isolate the issue. 3) If the problem persists, consult Docker/containerd logs for deeper diagnostics on the mount or overlay filesystem errors. No changes to commands or dependencies are recommended before resolving this infrastructure-level issue.
